identity:
Immediately after immersion into 471XE, the dive team confirmed probe observations that despite not being in any kind of chamber or underground, there were no visible light sources anywhere.  Sgt Simmons ordered the team to turn on their flashlights, and after doing so the team almost immediately came under attack by multiple XE338 entities.  Due to 471XE's effects on Netherum energy, Sgt Simmons ordered V78 to deter the attack using mathematics and the dive team formed a defensive formation while V78 fended off the XE338 attackers with repeated bolts of lightning.  While the attacks were effective, the light itself seemed to function as a deterrent and the dive team was able to withdraw through the aperture in short order with only Dr. Rodriguez suffering any injuries that required more than first aid.

Based on this incident, further travel to 471XE is prohibited without a CRYPTIC FORGE mathematician present and backed up by several high-powered light sources.

identity: You can use your powers to spin a web of illusion around yourself, increasing your attractiveness to a supernatural degree.  While the harsh light of the sun destroys the illusion, you need merely to move back into the shadows to restore it.
